_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Uyisithende {player_id} esigabeni sesimanje {num_players}-sithende se-Liar's Dice.
Izimfuno:
- Ngesikhathi sokuthi, ungakwazi ukuthi:
  1) Uthole ithuba elisha kanzima kakhulu noma eliphezulu (noma zombili) kulithuba lesimanje; n.g. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Uvome ithende lesiphelileyile kwa kubhala '[Call]'.

Ukuvoma:
  - Izinga elinganisa ukubala kwaleli gatsha kuhlanganisa zonke izithende kulapha kunciphisa kulithuba, umthendi ophelileyile uyalahleka isithende esiyodwa.
  - Ngokuphambene, uvumi uyalahleka isithende esiyodwa.
Uthende othinta 0 zithende uthathelelwa. Uthende ophethwe esiphelileyile uthola.

board.new_round: Umjikelezo omusha - Amadayisi asele: {dice_summary} Amadayisi akho amanje: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses: Umdlali {current_player_id} ubiza! Inani langempela lobuso {face_value} ngu {count}, okuyinto ENGAKHANI {quantity}. Umdlali {loser_id} (umthengisi wokugcina) ulahlekelwa idayisi elilodwa.
call.caller_loses: Umdlali {current_player_id} ubiza! Inani langempela lobuso {face_value} ngu {count}, okuyi- >= {quantity}. Umdlali {loser_id} (obizayo) ulahlekelwa idayisi elilodwa.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Call made with no prior bid.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Isenzo esingaqashelwa njengesifanele "[Bid: X, Y]" noma "[Call]". Isenzo esifakiwe: {action}

bid_reason.face_lower: Inani elisha elibhalwe {new_face_value} lingaphansi kwe- {current_face_value} yamanje.
bid_reason.face_range: Inani elibonakalayo kufanele libe phakathi kuka-1 no-6.
